incidents.title: Customer portal unavailable
incidents.description: Customers receive a service unavailable error when opening the support portal. Investigate the application pool and restore access.

incidents.title: Branch office router offline
incidents.description: The branch router is not responding and office users cannot reach internal services. Check power, uplink connectivity, and router health.

incidents.title: Suspicious sign-in alerts for finance accounts
incidents.description: Several finance accounts triggered unusual sign-in alerts. Review sign-in activity and confirm whether account containment is required.

incidents.title: Laptop battery no longer charging
incidents.description: A service desk laptop stops charging when connected to its power adapter. Replacement battery availability is being checked.

incidents.title: New starter cannot access project workspace
incidents.description: A new employee cannot open the project workspace despite completing onboarding. Verify group membership and workspace permissions.

incidents.title: Meeting room display instructions outdated
incidents.description: The printed connection instructions in meeting room Cedar refer to the previous wireless display system. Update the room guidance.

incidents.title: Expense application export fails
incidents.description: Exporting a monthly expense report produces an empty file. Review export logs and test reports containing multiple cost centers.

incidents.title: Intermittent guest Wi-Fi connection
incidents.description: Visitors report intermittent guest wireless disconnections near reception. Review access point health and wireless channel utilization.

incidents.title: Reception printer paper feed error
incidents.description: The reception printer repeatedly reports a paper feed fault. Cleaning and roller replacement restored normal printing.

notes.author: Desktop Support
notes.text: Cleaned the paper path, replaced the pickup roller, and confirmed successful printing with a ten-page test.

incidents.title: Shared mailbox permission missing
incidents.description: The customer service team could not open its shared mailbox. Restored the approved mailbox permissions and verified access.

notes.author: Identity Support
notes.text: Reapplied approved mailbox membership and verified access with the affected team.

incidents.title: Payroll application login failure
incidents.description: Payroll users could not sign in following a configuration update. Reverted the invalid authentication setting and verified sign-in.

notes.author: Application Support
notes.text: Reverted the incorrect authentication configuration and confirmed successful sign-in with payroll users.

incidents.title: VPN tunnel unavailable after gateway restart
incidents.description: Remote staff could not connect after the VPN gateway restarted. Restored the tunnel configuration and confirmed stable remote access.

notes.author: Network Operations
notes.text: Restored the tunnel configuration and verified connectivity from two remote test clients.

incidents.title: Endpoint protection signatures out of date
incidents.description: An engineering workstation failed to receive protection signature updates. Repaired the update service and verified current signatures.

notes.author: Security Operations
notes.text: Repaired the endpoint update service, applied current signatures, and completed a successful health check.

incidents.title: Service desk contact details incorrect
incidents.description: The internal help page listed an outdated service desk extension. Updated the contact details and checked the published page.

notes.author: Workplace Services
notes.text: Published the correct extension and support hours and verified the updated help page.

incidents.title: Conference room camera not detected
incidents.description: The video conferencing application does not detect the camera in meeting room Maple. Check the USB connection and device drivers.
